items.title: Approve the Minutes of the January 11, 2022 Meeting Consent Agenda
[Final Approval on First Appearance] Adopt the 2021 Annual Report
[Final Approval] Appoint Eric Rozell and Kevin Ortiz to the Community Advisory Committee
[Final Approval] Allocate $2,163,640 in Prop K Funds, with Conditions, for Two Requests
[Final Approval] Accept the Audit Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2021
[Final Approval] Approve Programming of $4,055,000 in Senate Bill 1 Local Partnership Program Formula Funds for Construction of the Yerba Buena Island West Side Bridges Seismic Retrofit Project
[Final Approval] Approve the San Francisco Transportation Investment and Growth Strategy 2021 Update
San Francisco’s Climate Action Plan 2021 Update
